name: OutBid Mania
description: Follows outbid.lol along with the copycat sites that have sprung up around it, tracking revenue figures and reporting daily on whether the bidding-site fad is actually growing. Narrow by design, so it earns its place only if that particular corner of the market matters to you.

official.title: OutBid Mania by Dragos
official.description: Tracks outbid.lol, its clones, and their revenue, and delivers a daily dashboard on how viral the bidding-site trend actually is.
